text:
rachel: Deploybot quarantined canary image gcr.io/redwood/api:canary-2026-03-15 — publish blocked.

deploybot: [automated] publish-quarantine: provenance annotation length mismatch detected across manifest list entries. summary:
```
inspect --platform=linux/amd64 -> annotations.provenance (len=512)
inspect --platform=linux/arm64  -> annotations.provenance (len=128)  # truncated signature
```

anil: that truncated length screams streaming truncation from the signing step. arm job retried once right before cosign.

jia: i saw the arm runner log: `curl: (18) transfer closed with outstanding read data` during cosign upload, then pipeline continued with a warning.

release-coordinator: ok options: pin to last-known-good digest and postpone canary; or attempt in-place re-sign on the same manifest (risky); or rebuild new image and push a fresh tag. thoughts?

rachel: prefer pin + postpone. customers shouldn't see a partial attestation. pin to `gcr.io/redwood/api@sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99dd00ee11ff22aa33bb44cc55dd66` from the March 14 canary. update release notes to note fallback and causes. :lock:

anil: agree. I'll file a quick rollback PR to the release manifest to point to the pinned digest. no manual retagging of the broken manifest.

jia: i'll re-run the arm pipeline with increased cosign timeout and switch uploader to multipart to avoid truncation. will also add a post-publish check that compares annotation lengths across platforms.

deploybot: action recorded: hold persists. suggested action list: [pin->gcr.io/redwood/api@sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99dd00ee11ff22aa33bb44cc55dd66, schedule republish in 03:00 UTC change window, add release-note: "canary deferred due to annotation parity mismatch; serving pinned to previous digest"].

release-coordinator: 03:00 UTC change window approved. i'll add PSA to #support and update the public release notes draft.

rachel: thanks. open a ticket for cosign uploader resilience and include the arm runner logs. assign to infra. :spiral_note_pad:

anil: filed INF-2026 - cosign uploader transfer-close during arm build; included logs and suggested multipart fix.

jia: once rebuilt and re-signed we'll request a new canary publish; no forcing retag on the pinned digest.

rachel: marking thread resolved after republish succeeds. closing when deploybot reports canary green. :white_check_mark:
